literal_meaning: কাউকে কোনোকিছু অনুভব করানো বা টের করানো
figurative_meaning_en: to subdue; to teach a lesson
similar_in_english: give someone a taste of their own medicine
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার শত্রুকে টের পাওয়ালো তার কাজের ফলাফল।
example_sentences_in_english: I'll make you feel it one day.
He taught his enemy a lesson by making him experience the consequences.
note: This idiom is often used in informal settings to express intent for retribution or correction through experience.
